 Wales have had a rough few months, and now Portugal roll into Cardiff to round it off. Not the kindest finish to a Nations League campaign.
 It’s the final game in Group A4. Portugal need a point to wrap up top spot after that 4-1 loss to Denmark, while bottom-placed Wales are scrapping to stay out of the automatic relegation places.

 Wales vs Portugal betting tips
 Wales host Portugal at Cardiff City Stadium on Tuesday 17 November, with kick-off at 7.45pm.
 Wales vs Portugal tip 1 – Portugal to win, both teams to score and over 3.5 goals ( 11/4 )
 Wales vs Portugal tip 2 – João Félix to score two or more goals ( 8/1 )
 Wales vs Portugal tip 3 – Portugal over 7.5 corners ( 3/1 )
 Goals Expected As Holders Visit Struggling Dragons
 Portugal have scored in all five of their Nations League games, 10 goals in total, but they haven’t been watertight either, conceding eight. Wales have shipped the same number and haven’t kept a clean sheet in 10 games in all competitions. Both teams have scored in each of Portugal’s four games since that 1-0 win over Wales in Lisbon, and four of their last five away competitive matches have gone over 2.5 goals.
 Portugal need a point to take top spot after the Denmark hammering, so expect them to come out firing. Wales have lost five of their last six, but they did find the net in Oslo and have Brennan Johnson and David Brooks who can nick one if the game opens up. Portugal winning a lively one with both sides scoring and four or more goals is a decent route to a big price.
 Wales vs Portugal tip 1 – Portugal to win, both teams to score and over 3.5 goals ( 11/4 )

 Félix Can Be The Difference Maker In Cardiff
 João Félix is the man Wales will be worrying about. He and Gonçalo Ramos have three goals each in this Nations League campaign, which is the same number Wales have scored as a whole team. Félix also got the only goal when these two met in Lisbon in September, and he’s expected to play off the main striker in the number 10 role again.
 Wales are without Ethan Ampadu in front of the back four, which takes away their best screen in midfield, and they’ve gone 10 games without a clean sheet. Portugal want to bounce back from the Denmark game, so Félix should see plenty of the ball between the lines and plenty of chances.
 Wales vs Portugal tip 2 – João Félix to score two or more goals ( 8/1 )

 Portugal To Pile On The Pressure
 Portugal will have most of the ball in Cardiff, and Wales are likely to defend deep with Ampadu suspended and Josh Sheehan set to come into midfield. That usually means wave after wave of attacks and plenty of corners as Wales block and clear. Portugal’s front line is full of players who cut inside and shoot, so a lot of those efforts will end up deflected behind.
